A toll on enrolments: take about a third of what the
university pays, pass two-thirds to agents
Crizac is a B2B platform. Counselling partners (agents) submit student applications through its portal; Crizac processes
them to partner universities and is paid a remuneration by the university when enrolment is confirmed, 45–90 days after
the course starts. It shares most of that with the agent who sourced the student.

providers forecast a deficit in 2025–26, rising to as much as 70%

commissions, and Crizac's top-3 partners are 44% of revenue on
90–180 day receivable terms (₹238 cr at Mar-26).
